name: KAT-Coder-V2.5-Dev (Kwaipilot)

lineage.how_derived: supervised fine-tuning on 127K examples, then reinforcement learning with sandboxed verifiers and harness-based rewards (technical report arXiv 2607.05471)

purpose: Kwaipilot states the open release is to strengthen community contact and show research results; audience developers and researchers in agentic coding.

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Card tag apache-2.0; the repository has no LICENSE file, so the text was not read.

architecture.kind: hybrid Gated DeltaNet + gated attention MoE (Qwen3.6 base)
architecture.why_this_design: Team chose Qwen3.6-35B-A3B as a widely recognized post-training base; Qwen3.6 specific penalties for parallel, failed and empty tool calls and repetition were added because a binary reward collapsed by epoch two.

variants.notes: 73 quantized models listed on the Hub

pc-12gb.notes: estimate from file size against the budget of docs/hardware (12 GB VRAM with 64 GB RAM); experts beyond VRAM stream from RAM, decode speed depends on that path
pc-12gb.variant: Q4_K_M class (size estimated, same shape as Ornith 35B)

pc-16gb.notes: estimate from file size against the budget of docs/hardware (16 GB VRAM with 64 GB RAM (reference)); experts beyond VRAM stream from RAM, decode speed depends on that path
pc-16gb.variant: Q4_K_M class (size estimated, same shape as Ornith 35B)

pc-24gb.notes: estimate from file size against the budget of docs/hardware (24 GB VRAM with 96 GB RAM); experts beyond VRAM stream from RAM, decode speed depends on that path
pc-24gb.variant: Q4_K_M class (size estimated, same shape as Ornith 35B)

pc-32gb.notes: estimate from file size against the budget of docs/hardware (32 GB VRAM with 128 GB RAM); experts beyond VRAM stream from RAM, decode speed depends on that path
pc-32gb.variant: Q4_K_M class (size estimated, same shape as Ornith 35B)

mac-16-24gb.notes: estimate from file size against the budget of docs/hardware (unified memory 16-24 GB, GPU share about 12 GB)
mac-16-24gb.variant: Q4_K_M class (size estimated, same shape as Ornith 35B)

mac-32gb.notes: estimate from file size against the budget of docs/hardware (unified 32 GB, GPU share about 22 GB)
mac-32gb.variant: Q4_K_M class (size estimated, same shape as Ornith 35B)

mac-64gb+.notes: estimate from file size against the budget of docs/hardware (unified 64 GB, GPU share about 52 GB)
mac-64gb+.variant: Q4_K_M class (size estimated, same shape as Ornith 35B)

engine_support.notes: same architecture as Ornith 35B, which Tona runs; the Qwen3.6 template handling would apply

benchmarks.name: Terminal-Bench 2.1
benchmarks.harness: average of Terminus-2 32.6 and Claude Code 49.44

strengths: Tool-call hygiene training (penalties for failed and empty calls)
weaknesses: Below Ornith-1.5 in the same size class on the vendor numbers (SWE-bench Verified 69.4 vs 79)
soft.behavior: Sampling T 1.0, top_p 0.95 (agentic); thinking default, non-thinking by API parameter.
soft.maturity: Kuaishou's Kwaipilot team; 691 likes; this is a Dev preview of a hosted model.

tona_fit.reason: Runs on the same architecture as Ornith 35B but vendor numbers are lower; no reason to prefer it without independent results.

sources.note: page text read through a summarizer (WebFetch)

open_questions: Per-language quality and independent coding evidence: the Aider polyglot board is stale (mirrors: last update 2025-11-20, no entry for any model of this database), LiveCodeBench and swebench.com publish no per-language numbers for it that we could retrieve. Check: our own Exercism polyglot run per language.
